column1: # Bengali pronunciation lexicon — genuinely-LEXICAL whole-word overrides for the vowel classes the rule engine
# cannot derive (closed-syllable ɔ→o, medial-ɔ retention, final-[o] retention; PROVEN lexical by the minimal
# pair মন[mon] vs কম[kɔm], identical shape, opposite outcome — an etymological tatsama/tadbhava split).
# PROVENANCE: 168 entries = (a) 156 CROSS-SOURCE CONSENSUS — our engine's own consonant skeleton with the
# vowel(s) set to the sequence that TWO independent human references AGREE on: wikipron ben (CC BY-SA, Kolkata)
# AND Bengali.AI DUAL-IPA (Dhaka; used OFFLINE for validation only, not redistributed). Two dialects agreeing
# filters out both wikipron noise and dialect-specific forms (it correctly ABSTAINS on জীবন→d͡ʒibɔn). Plus
# (b) a 12-word HAND supplement of high-frequency common words, each corroborated by DUAL and/or wikipron +
# standard-Kolkata knowledge (verb ô→o before -e: bole/d̪ʱoɾe/ɦole/boʃe; the িয়ে glide drop-j: nie/d̪ie/ɡie;
# এক→æk consistency: ækʈi/ækʰɔn; medial retention: kaɾone) — skipped where a source disagreed (চলে, পড়ে).
# Pronunciations are linguistic facts, in our convention, on the same CC-BY-SA footing as the committed wikipron
# referee. Overrides SHIPPED whole-word output only; the rule engine (phonemizeWordRules) — and the referee
# eval — bypass it and stay the honest, non-circular signal.
